notes: SO-101 Diffusion Policy fine-tune: inputs observation.state [6], observation.images.camera1 + observation.images.camera2 (3x480x640 each); output action [6]; n_obs_steps 2, horizon 16, n_action_steps 8, DDPM; dataset hrl7/so101-touch-test-3 (private, so joint names and camera viewpoints are unverified), 20000 steps. Normalizer min/max (wrist_roll up to 142.8, gripper 1.3-30.8) fit degree-mode joints plus a 0-100 gripper. Diffusion Policy does not mask missing cameras, so camera_map sends exactly camera1 (wrist) and camera2 (left AR0144 overhead half); camera2's real training viewpoint is an assumption to check on hardware. The server side needs vla_bridge/diffusion_policy_server.py (lerobot#3861 fix). verified_revision is informational: the bridge cannot pin a revision, so the server loads main. Evidence: vla_bridge/checkpoint_candidates.md.
